identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-14][csdlc-v2] Make typed card generation registry-aware and preparation-safe

values.task_boundary: Implement only the grouped C-SDLC v2 authority repair required by issue #5597.
deliverables: preparation-safe SIP, STP, and SRP operations
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Registry distinguishes legacy/import 1.0.3 from native compact v2 1.0.0 without false provenance
AC-2: Initialization validates registry and compact shape before writing and fails closed on incompatible truth
AC-3: Existing native 1.0.0 records remain readable and legacy 1.0.3 import remains separate
AC-4: Bootstrap and migration preserve explicit SIP operator constraints and SRP review scope including explicit none
AC-5: Typed SIP operator-constraint replacement is preparation-safe in initialized, ready, and bound phases
AC-6: Typed STP acceptance replacement atomically revalidates SPP step and VPP proof-role coverage
AC-7: Bound SRP replanning is preparation-safe and review assignment synchronizes authoritative scope immediately
AC-8: Focused Gate 2, identity, review, migration, and Gate 9 parity tests plus strict lint and owner validation pass
AC-9: Exact-revision review has no unresolved actionable finding and blocked consumer packets can use typed repair
